about:
I'm Comr. Josiah Adeyemo, a Nigerian software engineer, builder, and student unionist, also known as Billioncodes. My work spans web interfaces, backend services, and the connections between them.

I've worked with React, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python across roles documented in this portfolio at Korpeatech, CampusHub, Billioncodes, Crown International, and Eduvella. I enjoy turning a complex requirement into an interface people can use and code a team can maintain.

Beyond engineering, I serve in the National Association of Nigerian Students (NANS), Southwest Zone D. I served as Assistant General Secretary in 2025 and emerged as Zonal Coordinator in 2026, for the 2026–2027 tenure. Student welfare, representation, and access to the conditions needed to learn are central to that work. In 2026 that has meant speaking up on student housing rents, campus safety during the Osun election, the safety of prospective corps members, and working with the police on student security.

I also write about technology and opportunity. In my writing for Billioncodes, I've explored how education and international collaboration can open doors for African tech talent.
